summary: Add --direction (from/to/both) support to planfile sync fleet

delivery.outcome: Allow planfile sync fleet to run inbound (from), outbound (to), or bidirectional (both) GitHub synchronization.
nonGoals: Changing default direction away from 'from' for existing callers.

interfaceChanges: Add optional direction='from' to sync_fleet and --direction CLI option to fleet_cmd
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching planfile/cli/groups/sync/fleet.py and tests/test_sync_fleet.py.

validation.evidence: Unit tests verify direction forwarding and validation; governance-check passes.
